name: Kingdomino

categories.label: Properties
categories.help: For each connected property: its tile count times its crowns, added together.

categories.label: Middle Kingdom
categories.help: Tick if your castle is in the centre of your 5x5 grid (10 points).

categories.label: Harmony
categories.help: Tick if your kingdom is a full 5x5 with no discarded tiles (5 points).

categories.label: Largest property
categories.help: Tile count of your biggest property; the larger wins a tie.

categories.label: Total crowns
categories.help: All crowns in your kingdom; second tie-break.

notes: Middle Kingdom and Harmony are optional rules in the rulebook; a loader may want them off by default. Tie-break: largest property, then crowns, then shared.
